verification.default_mode: standard-library static word and range checks
verification.optional_mode: Capstone5.0.7 after image validation, listing identity in memory only
verification.compare_cap: 4 times generated JSON bytes plus one sentinel read

limits: The complete II33 record, including original code/decoder/listing provenance, is checked before public metadata is added.
callers and writer_order contain manual static interpretations checked against pinned original ranges; they are not automatically inferred execution traces.
Default verification uses only Python standard-library checks of image, source ranges, branch words, literal words and descriptors. It does not import Capstone.
capstone_version, decoded_instruction_count, reproduction_source_sha256 and source_listing_sha256 inside observations preserve historical II33 provenance.
Optional Capstone checking re-creates the old listing in memory after exact image verification. No listing, firmware bytes or assets are exported.
The two inputs are 48-byte internal parameter records, not pixel buffers. No menu reachability, actual capture order, concurrency safety or reuse history is established.
Static instruction order only, not execution, synchronization proof, observed reuse history or camera reachability.
Guarded cache producers return singleton4047B754+14 manager; actual initialized cache contents and guard success are not observed.
R2=0 disables only the final notification tail; it does not disable the separate manager+0x0C helper call.
Both selected setters modify other payload fields, not selector5/6 bytes object+15/+16. Existing payload values are copied; their earlier producers remain unresolved.
The immediate setter argument is word(R5); the inspected path sets R5=caller_object+6C80 at4BF580. No exhaustive caller CFG or alias-free intervening calls are proved.
All aligned A32 scan matches outside these two callers remain syntactic candidates. No exhaustive Thumb/indirect caller recovery or actual menu event attribution.
